work.name: Quantmetry – Capgemini Invent
highlights: Small fiber neuropathy detection in skin biopsy images: developed algorithms for assisted diagnosis, co-inventor of diagnostic device (Patent Application No. 22 00588), and participation in retrospective/prospective clinical trials.
Development of the MAPIE library for Conformal Prediction (focus on multiclass and multilabel tasks); presented at DFUQ workshop (ICML 2022) and COPA 2023.
Adaptive recall control for semantic segmentation: methodology providing recall guarantees and dynamic thresholding.
Uncertainty quantification for follicle detection in mouse ovaries: integrated biological priors to improve reliability.
Novel conformal prediction methods for Gaussian Processes regression with robust theoretical coverage guarantees.
